name: Klaviyo Connector
description: Email/SMS marketing automation via your own Klaviyo account -- profiles and consent, lists and segments, campaigns (email + SMS), flows, events and metrics, catalogs, coupons, reviews, templates, tags, and webhooks. Bring-your-own-account (BYOK): connect your own Klaviyo private API key, every call runs against your own account and your own sending quota.

tools.name: connect_klaviyo
tools.description: Connect Klaviyo by saving your own private API key, after checking it actually works. Get it from Klaviyo: Settings > API Keys > Create Private API Key.

api_key.description: Klaviyo private API key (Settings > API Keys in your Klaviyo account). Verified against Klaviyo before being saved.
api_key.title: Api Key

tools.name: disconnect_klaviyo
tools.description: Disconnect Klaviyo: deletes the saved API key. Nothing in your Klaviyo account is changed -- lists, flows, campaigns, and profiles all stay exactly as they are; only this connector's access to them stops.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_klaviyo_connection
tools.description: Check whether Klaviyo is currently connected (does not reveal the saved API key).

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: get_klaviyo_account
tools.description: Read the connected Klaviyo account's own profile: contact email, timezone, public API key, and whether it's a test account.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.

secrets.name: klaviyo_api_key
secrets.description: Your Klaviyo private API key, from Klaviyo Account > Settings > API Keys > Create Private API Key. Needs read/write scopes for the resources you want this connector to manage (profiles, lists, campaigns, etc.) -- Klaviyo's own key-scoping screen lets you pick exactly which ones.

pricing.notes: Fixed platform scale {0,8,16,20,40,60} per canonical PRICING_POLICY.md. Not a Google-backed app, no x1.8 markup.
